name: animated-subscribe-button
title: Animated Subscribe Button
description: A toggle button whose label slides away and the next one drops in. A real button with aria-pressed, in controlled or uncontrolled form.

props.name: children
props.description: Two nodes: the idle label, then the subscribed label.

props.name: subscribed
props.description: Controlled state. Omit it and the button keeps its own.

props.name: onSubscribedChange
props.description: Called with the next state when the button is pressed.
